design_specification.subject: one solid folded note with a wide open stepped corner
design_specification.idea: A saved fragment ready to be returned to: one filled note silhouette, not an outline document glyph.
design_specification.construction: Upright 4:5 body. Broad ink mass with matching modest corner radii. The top-right corner turns back as one coral trapezoid occupying about one quarter of the body width. Leave one paper-colored open stair gap between folded corner and body, no narrow tip, no internal text lines.
design_specification.color: Ink body, one coral fold, warm paper full background. Broad distinct color roles.
design_specification.material: Flat filled planes, no depth required: the turn is defined by the notch.
design_specification.reference: Take Craft reference shared curve/spacing consistency only; no four-piece flower/cross or its palette.
design_specification.small_size: One stepped corner must remain open at 32px.
design_specification.difference: One enclosing solid silhouette, unlike the open two-strip gesture and shallow folded object.
design_specification.risk: Could still resemble a generic file; avoid outlined rectangle and text-line bars.

observations: Four broad curved pieces share rounded terminals and a narrow central cross-shaped gap.
Pink and bright blue upper pieces contrast with two navy lower pieces; shallow edge highlights sit on a light tile.
transfer: Use a shared curve and gap-width rule across related parts.
Assign each color a clear compositional role.
avoid: Do not copy the four-sector arrangement or its pink-blue-navy placement.
Do not assume the observed surface treatment requires a glass rendering for this product.
